en.headline: Man reports HK$800,000 taken from Beacon Peak flat
en.dek: Police said a 28-year-old man reported signs of a search at a flat on Yin Ping Road on Saturday night, with jewellery and cash missing.
body: Police are investigating a burglary at Beacon Peak in Beacon Hill after a resident reported that jewellery and cash were missing from his flat.

Officers said they received the report at about 9pm on Saturday from a 28-year-old man. He told them he had found signs that the flat at 9 Yin Ping Road had been searched. A preliminary count put the missing items at about HK$700,000 in jewellery and HK$100,000 in cash, police said.
The case has been classified as burglary and handed to the first team of the Sham Shui Po district crime unit. Police said no one had been arrested.

zh.headline: 筆架山豪宅單位報失約80萬元財物
zh.dek: 警方指周六約晚上9時接獲28歲男子報案，延坪道Beacon Peak單位有搜掠痕跡，失去珠寶及現金，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方正在調查筆架山一宗爆竊案。一名住戶周六晚上報稱，單位內的珠寶首飾及現金不見。
警方表示，周六約晚上9時接獲一名28歲男子報案，指延坪道9號Beacon Peak的單位有搜掠痕跡。初步點算，相信失去約70萬元珠寶首飾及10萬元現金。
案件列作爆竊，交由深水埗警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進。警方說暫未有人被捕。
